contact_lp.note: frozen angles; frontier rows are tight in their own contact graphs

rotation_lp.note: positions + per-square rotation; no first-order step lowers L on a record row

rewire.note: contact axis/sign rewriting from a record row; no gain

recovery.note: recovers exactly the rows whose optimum is the grid; misses every off-grid optimum

grain_injection.note: heterogeneous nucleation + repair + LP cannot reach the 45-degree notch; best is target + 0.5
